title: cal gotchas --json
description: Gotchas semantically recalled for a query, best first.

schema_version.description: Major version of this payload's shape. A reader refuses a version newer than it knows.

results.description: The rows, best match (or newest) first.

notice.description:
Present only when `results` is empty because this machine couldn't run the query (no
embedding model for `decisions` / `gotchas`), so a reader can tell that from no match.

rationale.description: ADR rationale ("why"), when the decision has one. NULL for gotchas/todos.

extractor.description: Who wrote it: llm, heuristic, user, agent, or an importer such as claude-memory.

replaces.description: Ids of the facts it actively supersedes.

support.description: 1 + the other sessions that reaffirmed it.

match.description: Set by the contradiction guard only.

RecallHit.description:
A semantically-recalled fact (decision/gotcha) with the thread it came from, when it was
decided and where it stands ([`FactStatus`]: a superseded hit names what replaced it).

FactStatus.description:
Where a fact stands, in priority order: an active `supersedes` link points at it
(`superseded`), an unresolved stale / wrong flag (`flagged`), an active `contradicts` link
on either side (`disputed`), else `current`.

threadId.description: Its session thread; None for a recorded or imported fact (no session to cite).

LinkedFact.description:
The other side of an active link: the fact that replaced this one, one it replaces, or one
that disputes it.

GuardMatch.description:
How close a contradiction-guard hit is to the proposal: `close` at or above
[`GUARD_CLOSE`] similarity, else `related`.
